# w3ws v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

Ethereum websocket library for Elixir

## Pages

- [W3WS](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [W3WS.ABI](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.ABI.md): Ethereum ABI Functions

- [W3WS.Env](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Env.md): W3WS Envelope

- [W3WS.Event](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Event.md): Event struct representing a decoded event

- [W3WS.Handler](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Handler.md): Base module for W3WS handlers
- [W3WS.Handler.BlockRemovalHandler](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Handler.BlockRemovalHandler.md): Handler which filters removed events by buffering received events until
future blocks are created.
- [W3WS.Handler.DefaultHandler](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Handler.DefaultHandler.md): Default W3WS handler which logs received events

- [W3WS.Handler.GenServerHandler](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Handler.GenServerHandler.md): A GenServer implementation of `W3WS.Handler`. Useful for building out a 
handler with a GenServer.
- [W3WS.Handler.TimedRemovalHandler](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Handler.TimedRemovalHandler.md): Handler which filters out removed events using a time-delayed buffer. 
- [W3WS.Listener](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Listener.md): W3WS Listener which handles the websocket connection and subscribes to
configured ethereum events.
- [W3WS.ListenerManager](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.ListenerManager.md): W3WS Listener Manager. Starts up and manages listeners using provided `:listeners`
and/or by loading listener config from the given `:otp_app`.

- [W3WS.Message](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Message.md): W3WS Messages for ethereum jsonrpc
- [W3WS.RawEvent](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.RawEvent.md): W3WS RawEvent represents an encoded event.

- [W3WS.Replayer](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Replayer.md): A `Task` that replays past events.
- [W3WS.Rpc](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Rpc.md): W3WS RPC Server
- [W3WS.Util](https://w3ws.hexdocs.pm/W3WS.Util.md): Utility functions
